items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: his alto would sit on his stomach, a la Pete Brown, you know, sitting right on it like a toy set.

ctx.x: to have dances. So every day, all these musicians would meet up at the Barn and just have like an all-afternoon jam session until the night. It usually ended up with Harry Pettiford, Oscar Pettiford's older brother, he was an alto saxophone player... It usually ended up with everybody sitting around listening to Harry play. He was really fantastic. And I doubt if he ever made a record. But the man, he... He was a heavyset guy, and his alto would sit on his stomach, a la Pete Brown, you know, sitting right on it…
Benny had a very fine guy who I am quite sure you remember -- Bumps Myers.
